implementationStatus: Content and final shared-contract rules source-ready; runtime verification is performed separately by the coordinating agent.
evidenceLimit: The API advertises initial_hp=0 alongside positive hp. The local ordinary identity definition starts at advertised maximum HP; that zero is not imported as zero starting HP. This is a local interpretation, not an explicit API rule.
The current official ordinary identity version is used. National-war reveal/half-HP text and ten-year variants do not substitute its rules.

The archive retains primary URLs, HTTP status, decoded-body hashes and exact current skill text. Static source readiness does not claim runtime acceptance or an official cross-skill FAQ for inferred implementation details.
Both official API quality values are 稀有. Ordinary here identifies the current identity variant, rather than claiming the website quality is 普通.

The slash-separated current 忠允 text is mapped to two independently shared per-turn groups: damage/recovery and hand count changes. This follows the historical official expanded two-part release wording; damage is not broadened to all HP loss.

Current 忠允 damage says 一名角色 rather than 其他角色. The engine existing attack-range definition supplies other living participants as legal damage targets. Treating self as outside one own attack range is an implementation interpretation; no separate official self-target FAQ is claimed.
Hand qualification uses complete source/destination batch before and after counts, rather than card movement alone; a same-count atomic hand exchange does not qualify.

The forced choice only offers branches with actual legal targets. Foreign discard observes the existing protected-card legality and does not offer a decline. These are engine legality mappings, not extra restrictions claimed as quoted official text.

Current 神品 does not explicitly enumerate card zones or explain cross-skill effective-color cases. Hand/Equipment replacement and current effective-color comparisons reuse the shared judgment replacement contract. No official 红颜/神品 or suit-less-card cross FAQ is claimed.

finalRuleMapping.qualification: Owner current HP equals current hand count. Damage and actual recovery share one turn allowance; plain non-damage HP loss does not qualify.
options: damage when an other living target is currently in attack range

finalRuleMapping.qualification: Owner current HP equals hand count and the corresponding complete batch hand-zone before count differs from after count.
options: discard only when another living owner has an actually discardable HE card
finalRuleMapping.discardExecution: Owner chooses exactly one legal Hand or Equipment card of the selected target; discard and all movement children complete before continuation. There is no decline option after choosing this branch.
